mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RESTORE_DAILY_APP_TARGET WHERE batch_name = #{batchName} AND status != 'DONE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RESTORE_DAILY_APP_TARGET WHERE batch_name = #{batchName} AND status = 'FAILED'
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO RESTORE_DAILY_APP_TARGET ( batch_name, usage_date, line_id, application_id, status, status_updated_at, retry_count, created_at ) SELECT #{batchName}, usage_date, line_id, application_id, 'PENDING', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) FROM DAILY_APP_TOTAL_DATA WHERE usage_date >= #{startInclusive} AND usage_date < #{endExclusive} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT( 'p1:daily_app:', DATE_FORMAT(t.usage_date, '%Y%m%d'), ':', t.line_id, ':', t.application_id ) AS idempotencyKey, d.usage_date AS usageDate, d.line_id AS lineId, fl.family_id AS familyId, d.application_id AS applicationId, d.individual_usage_data AS individualUsageBytes, d.shared_usage_data AS sharedUsageBytes, d.qos_usage_data AS qosUsageBytes, 0 AS expireEpochSeconds FROM RESTORE_DAILY_APP_TARGET t JOIN DAILY_APP_TOTAL_DATA d ON d.usage_date = t.usage_date AND d.line_id = t.line_id AND d.application_id = t.application_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN FAMILY_LINE fl ON fl.line_id = t.line_id WHERE t.id = #{id}

SELECT id, batch_name, usage_date, line_id, application_id, status, status_updated_at, worker_id, retry_count, last_error_code, last_error_message, created_at FROM RESTORE_DAILY_APP_TARGET WHERE batch_name = #{batchName} AND ( status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRYABLE') OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND status_updated_at < #{leaseExpiredBefore}) ) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE RESTORE_DAILY_APP_TARGET SET status = 'RETRYABLE', status_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), worker_id = NULL, last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL WHERE batch_name = #{batchName} AND status = 'FAILED'
